$comment: Reth-specific safety policy. Detection may observe many node conditions, but only a narrow subset can recommend bounded systemd restart; stateful, credential, storage, and exposure risks escalate.

node_unreachable_recovery.$comment: How Mesh responds to a synthetic node_unreachable signal — emitted by the ingester after N consecutive RPC-failure ticks. SSH and RPC are different network paths: if SSH is reachable the host is alive but the EL service is wedged → restart fixes it. If SSH is also down the host itself is gone → escalate. Default 'escalate_only' is the safe choice; operators with a reliable SSH executor can opt into 'ssh_restart_with_approval' to let Mesh propose (still approval-gated) a systemd restart.

evidence_sufficiency.$comment: Forces escalation when the assembled evidence pack is too sparse to defend an action. The EvidenceService applies its own defaults; this block lets operators override per-policy.
